notes: Modified cash basis village; trimmed PDF has 11 pages (source_page = trimmed page: 1 Statement of Net Position, 2 Statement of Activities, 3 governmental balance sheet, 4 governmental receipts/disbursements/fund balances, 5 proprietary net position, 6 proprietary revenues/expenses, 7-8 proprietary cash flows, 9 budget-actual all funds, 10-11 General Fund departments combining). Governmental from Total column (General + Street). Governmental 'Taxes - Other' 16,655.75 split into Homestead 7,583.11 and Other 9,072.64 using General Fund departments schedule (p10); 'Other' receipts 60,504.09 split into Franchise/Capital/Patronage 47,827.57, General dept Other 12,113.84 (= 90.36+211.14+1,411.58+304.00+10,096.76) and Street Other 562.68. Interest income 16,369.68 and transfers are printed under Other Financing Sources below Total Receipts. Transfers in total column 140,826.69 is net (General +150,972.72, Street -10,146.03), recorded as transfers_in; business-type transfers out 140,826.69 mirrors it. Beginning cash is fund balance 270,079.23 before restatement; restatement 2,341.73 recorded as adjustment (restated beginning 272,420.96). Identity: 270,079.23 + 357,014.80 + 16,369.68 - 520,926.89 + 140,826.69 + 2,341.73 = 265,705.24. Business-type (Water, Sewer, Garbage; Total column p6): no single receipts total printed so reported receipts = operating 210,146.50 + interest 301.47 = 210,447.97 (computed); disbursements total 429,922.79 is the Statement of Activities business-type expenses (p2) = operating expenses 103,276.94 + capital outlay 195,454.00 + interest 27,551.52 + principal 103,640.33. Bond/note issuance 252,550 recorded as business_type.debt_proceeds. Business 'measure' = cash: beginning cash and cash equivalents 807,910.76 and ending 700,159.25 from the cash flow statement (p8); 807,910.76 + 210,447.97 - 429,922.79 + 252,550 - 140,826.69 = 700,159.25. Net position (807,582.28 to 699,830.77) differs by sales tax payable. Sales tax collected liability categorized as other liabilities. Budget-and-actual all funds schedule (p9) is a broad all-funds summary overlapping the basic statements and is not recorded; General Fund detail taken from the more detailed departmental schedule p10-11 (no double counting). Department columns recorded under fund General with department = column name; capital outlay lines have no object breakdown. Detail (user 2026-10-27): per-fund lines from the fund statements' columns (p4, p6) added for the funds that had no schedule. The General Fund departments lines (p10-11) are kept (they tie to the General column); the General interest income line (printed below Total Receipts, outside_printed_total) is in section revenue so governmental detail ties to the top-level receipts. Attempt 3 (targeted re-check): balance sheet governmental lines now from the governmental funds Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Fund Balances (p3, Total column: cash and cash equivalents 257,520.14, cash with county treasurer 8,185.10, fund balance Unassigned 265,705.24; totals equal the government-wide Governmental column on p1); proprietary lines and combined totals stay from the Statement of Net Position (p1). The General Fund detail 'Interest income' 16,369.68 is now category Interest Income (was investment income). Intergovernmental 86,392.91 holds no homestead/credit/pro-rate amounts (General municipal equalization 20,877.86, Street 65,515.05), so it is not split. Read pages 1-11 of 11.
